email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoCardolol patient with occasional dizziness
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a staff pharmacist at Fictional General Hospital (demo) (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 26-year-old female patient with a history of hypertension received their first dose of DemoCardolol (dose: 5mg) via oral.
Treatment started on 2026-03-28.
Approximately 6 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed occasional dizziness.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
K. Reyes (fictional reporter)
Fictional General Hospital (demo)
Contact: demo.reporter673@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
